text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
—The time for the decisive battle has 
arrived. The finale of the Classic Triple 
Crown: the Kikuka Sho. Narita Top Road 
remained calm and composed.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She made a declaration: if she runs with 
all her might, she can deliver brilliance 
to everyone—and become that kind of 
Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And the ones to receive that brilliance 
included Admire Vega. She wanted to change 
her—the girl willing to throw away 
everything just to win.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Narita Top Road thirsts for victory. To 
prove that Umamusume can grow through the 
power of bonds— she will run the Kikuka 
Sho with all her might!
